services.desc: Come by during operating hours for a tasting, to purchase a bottle, or to savor our extensive menu of craft cocktails. We have 10 distinct spirits, and our cocktail menu is rotated seasonally, so we are sure to have something for everyone. Ask one of our bartenders for recommendations based on your taste preferences. Still not sure what you want? Try one of our flights (four 1/2 oz tasters) of any of our products.
